title: Piplup — A Very Proud Little Penguin
description: A large, freestanding Sinnoh starter with a rounded blue hood, sculpted white cheeks, shining oval eyes, a golden bill, twin chest buttons, a little feathered tail and one flipper raised in a confident wave. Broad webbed feet support the internally braced figure.
